prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Katy, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported wrist fracture. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1411; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene of a two-vehicle collision in Katy, Texas, I observed a rear-end collision involving a sedan and a pickup truck traveling in the same direction on the roadway. Driver 1, operator of the sedan, stated that traffic ahead had slowed and that Driver 2, operator of the pickup, did not stop in time and struck the rear of the sedan. Driver 2 stated that the sedan stopped abruptly in front of them. Visible damage was present to the rear bumper and trunk of the sedan and the front bumper of the pickup. A Passenger in the sedan was evaluated on scene and reported no complaints. Driver 1 reported pain in the right wrist and was transported by EMS for further evaluation. Both drivers were cooperative. No citations were issued at the time of this report, pending review of witness statements and vehicle inspection.
